content.title: Download & control YouTube TV on your TV
content.text: Ready to watch your favorite programs on your big screen? To watch on select TV devices, you can download our TV app, watch by opening YouTube TV inside the YouTube app on your TV, or stream YouTube TV from your mobile device or computer using a supported device below. Have a question about a specific TV? See the list below for instructions on how to download the YouTube TV app on some common TVs. Subscribe to the YouTube Viewers channel for the latest news, updates, and tips. Download the YouTube TV app To watch YouTube TV on your TV, download the YouTube TV app to your smart TV or streaming device. If YouTube TV is not pre-installed, you can download the app by going to the app store on your smart TV. Note: The YouTube TV app is different from the YouTube app. Be sure you’re searching for YouTube TV in the app store on your TV device. Play YouTube TV using your device remote Sign up for an add-on network using your TV device Set up the YouTube TV app To see which smart TVs and media players you can use to watch YouTube TV, check out this page. For instructions on how to set up YouTube TV on some common devices, read below. Make sure to sign up for YouTube TV first if you haven't already. Chromecast with Google TV Android TV Xbox consoles Playstation devices Samsung TVs LG TVs Apple TV Roku Fire TV Vizio SmartCast TiVo Stream 4K Xfinity Flex and XClass TVs Stream or cast YouTube TV to your TV You can watch YouTube TV on your TV by casting or streaming to it from a mobile device or computer. Supported devices Play YouTube TV using Google Home Open YouTube TV inside of the YouTube app On some devices, you can access YouTube TV from the YouTube app directly. To do this, first make sure the YouTube app is downloaded on your device. Note: This currently works on certain devices only. We’ll expand this to as many other devices as we can over time. Open the YouTube app on your device. On the left side navigation, scroll down to the bottom to find YouTube TV. Select YouTube TV to open the app. If it’s your first time doing this, you’ll need to sign in to YouTube TV. Troubleshooting If you're having trouble with YouTube TV, check out these troubleshooting tips or send feedback to YouTube. Tips & tricks: If you're part of a family group, switch accounts by signing out of and in to a different account. YouTube TV also works on other devices and platforms, like your phone and computer.
